items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I played with the old, the old, the old Olympia band with Arnold De Pass.

ctx.x: I was born in 1904 in New Orleans, Louisiana. Which day? November 11th. Oh, yeah. And I played with the old, the old, the old Olympia band with Arnold De Pass. He's a drummer. He had a band around there. Oh, I think he played with Kid Punch too. Yeah. Well, they were much older musicians than me.
Excuse me. Who else was with you and Arnold De Pass in that band? Well, I can't call what.
